tasks.corrected_reference_answer: BaseSegment caches computed properties with cached_property (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/base.py:385-513). Initialization and assigning segments call _recalculate_caches (308-318), while invalidate_caches recurses through children then clears self (889-898). Clearing pops a hardcoded key list, so subsequent access recomputes successfully removed entries (836-852). This revision has defects: descendant_type_set and direct_descendant_type_set keys have trailing spaces and is_templated is omitted. Thus it does not guarantee complete invalidation, nor does child mutation automatically notify ancestors.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: There is sequential startup work: paths_from_path materializes os.walk for a directory and finds ignore files (src/sqlfluff/core/linter/linter.py:1013-1045), and lint_paths collects expanded filenames before starting the runner/progress bar (1160-1199). These can add discovery latency and memory cost on large trees. The source alone does not establish that they dominate parsing, templating or linting, or quantify slowdown; representative profiling is required. ParallelRunner explicitly streams partial jobs so main-thread I/O can overlap workers (src/sqlfluff/core/linter/runner.py:128-145).

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ParallelRunner creates its pool with process count, initializer and config arguments (src/sqlfluff/core/linter/runner.py:136-140); _create_pool delegates to POOL_TYPE (178-180), and MultiProcessRunner sets multiprocessing.Pool (188-203). No maxtasksperchild is supplied here, so worker recycling is not configured by this path. The source documents parent-controlled SIGINT handling and delayed exception propagation, but does not explain why recycling was omitted or prove memory/reliability tradeoffs. Adding it would require a separately evaluated design change.
